given: User A has a pending manual renewal
the response contains different access values under lowercase and title-case header names
then: the trace records the selected header value and installed expiry
a service-side protected validation records the accepted identity

assertions.name: selected access is one of the two supplied values
installed expiry equals selected credential expiry
current BFF signature and expiry verification passes
current SDK protected handler accepts selected credential
accepted service-side identity matches installed access subject

limits: Exact React Provider, reducers, mounted Timeout hook, service helpers, and Axios request/response interceptors execute.
Network responses and JWT payloads are controlled fixture inputs. Cryptographic validity is not established by the client probes.
No native browser lifecycle, real UI rendering, transport, or business mutations execute.
P018 additionally executes real current RSA/JWT verification and SDK filtering. It does not execute a live business service.

signed_peer.verifier: current BFF JwtTokenUtil and current SDK AuthTokenFilter

protected_validation.limit: Actual current BFF verifier and SDK filter; synthetic servlet handler. No live business service or distributed revocation validation.
